result.title: Structure Before Intelligence: Gating What Agentic Scientific Workflows Release
result.comment: 21 pages: 10-page main paper and 11-page supplement; 2 figures
result.summary: An agentic scientific workflow can run to completion and still release wrong results: a silent numerical error, a stale input, or a defect in a shared upstream step can contaminate several outputs while a sibling branch stays correct. We treat trust in such results as a release decision. A harness around the workflow's directed acyclic graph (DAG) decides which outputs may be used: it enforces mandatory checks, contains failures to the affected branch, recomputes from tracked versions, adds validators, and releases a result only if a risk model estimates its probability of being invalid as low. Language-model agents work inside the harness, choosing corrective actions and reviewing releases, but cannot override it. On 60 held-out paired instances of two workflows with injected faults, we switched components on and off. Each supplied a different property. Containment and recovery raised the number of correct results. Validation supplied safety: fixed rules without validation released 37 invalid results, while validating every candidate released none. Risk estimation supplied efficiency, matching that safety with 31% fewer validators at somewhat lower yield, although better targeting than random validation was not shown. Lineage evidence helped on one workflow. The language model added no measurable benefit: whether invalid results escaped depended on the harness, not the model. This proof of concept points to a practical path: placing agents inside explicit release-control structure can keep released scientific results trustworthy, and it gives more capable agents a measurable baseline to improve on.

AI.brief_summary: 论文为 agentic 科学工作流提出一个围绕 DAG 的发布控制 harness：强制检查、把故障限制在受影响分支、按版本重算、加入验证器，并由风险模型判断输出是否可以发布；在注入故障的 60 个配对实例上开关各组件做消融，发现隔离与恢复提高正确数、验证提供安全性、风险估计以更少验证器达到同等安全，语言模型本身无可测增益。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但「验证器 + 风险阈值决定是否发布」可能为推理中的 STOP 决策与证据获取的成本—收益权衡提供可核查的概念类比，其语言模型无增益、收益来自外部结构的结论也提示值得对照结构与模型能力的分工。
